name: Authored ERD view
explanation: Draws an ERD revision's own offline drawing as authored, re-serialized from an allowlist with ids namespaced to the view, binds only declared elements to their pinned entities, and lists the whole directory with drawn and not-drawn membership. Overlays compose over their exact baseline revision.

code.note: Composes overlays over the exact baseline ERD revision, refuses a drawing that fails validation or the allowlist, and binds directory rows and drawn elements to the same pins.
Re-serializes the drawing from XML tokens, keeping only static drawing elements, presentation attributes and fragment links, and refuses anything else.
